items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution, admit no new delivery work, and make no scaling or monetization decision until finance-grade attribution and cost coverage exist. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The full $4.92 is in aggregate tracking_id "other"; named site rows show $0 attributed commission, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift are unsupported. AI usage was $996.71149775 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,509 calls and 39 instrumented sites, implying $0.1809 per call; this is not contribution margin because infrastructure, domain, hosting, labor, and other costs are unavailable. Analytics is unavailable for all 38 expected sites, so cost-to-learn and revenue efficiency are not calculable. Budget ceilings are blank, creating unbounded exposure. Retain only existing work, release capacity through the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z, and execute the queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after that slot clears. Do not claim revenue or lift from clicks, impressions, ordered items, shipped items, conversions, or proposals.

Finance disposition: the only calculable AI-only difference is $4.92 aggregate commission minus $996.71149775 AI cost = -$991.79149775, but it must not be labeled contribution margin because the periods differ and non-AI costs are missing. Cost-to-learn is not calculable: the 5 proven outcomes are not established incremental learnings, and 43 improvements await measurement. Minimum measurement is a dated ledger joining site/content identifier, experiment exposure, attributable revenue and commission, AI cost, infrastructure cost, domain/hosting cost, and outcome status for the same window; separately restore GA4/GSC coverage for the 38 expected analytics sites. Until then, use clicks and impressions only as activity metrics, not financial performance.
